chunks: Ammar narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام, who said: He said to me:
O Ammar, charity given in secret, by Allah, is better than charity given openly; and likewise, by Allah, worship in secret is better than worship in public.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous and superior in merit
key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charity given for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: Why is secret charity and private worship better than doing them openly?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that concealed acts of devotion carry greater virtue than public ones, specifically in charity and worship. It emphasizes sincerity and purity of intention, directing the believer toward deeds done for Allah alone rather than for public recognition.
